API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APICloud & Branch Connector GroupsGet Ec Route By Id
Get Ec Route By Id
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/route/:ecRouteId

Retrieves the details of the Cloud or Branch Connector route within a specific VM based on the provided route ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

ecRouteId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector route ID.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
ecVmId
int32

The VM ID of the Cloud or Branch Connector group.

id
int32

The route ID.

meta
object
modTime
int64

The time when the route details were last modified.

modUid
int32

ID of the user who created or last modified the route details.
